msg: There are two groups of colours that gnomes can fall into. One group provides more points than the other group but this is also dependent on the multiplier. E.g. group 1 has colours such as purple whereas group 2 has colours such as green, brown, blue. It is wise to see which colours give you which points but also dependent on the multiplier. For example, on a 1x a purple would give 0 points but when the multiplier is 5x it seems there's a higher chance to get more points where a purple with a 5x can give sometimes 40 mushrooms. Group 2 are safer colours and on average will give more points but when its 5x there's a chance to get more mushrooms from group 1 gnomes but there's also a chance to get 0 points. The gnomes also have different head shapes, it is unclear how this affects the points but should also be tested.
